listing.name: Triad Shields 1.2.3
listing.summary: Adds Triad Shields, an unused system supposadly made for omega. Currently, the Tesseract and Facet have it, but you can get it as a hullmod if you beat a hypershunt.

description:
Adds Triad Shields, an unused system supposadly made for omega. Currently, the Tesseract and Facet have it, but you can get it as a hullmod if you beat a hypershunt.

Triad Shields are a cell-based skinshield.

Yes, this buffs omega.

No, its not balanced.

No, its not entirely polished. Yes, it works.

This is primarily a fucko mod I made just as a proof of concept, but I thought, hey, wouldnt it be cool if you could use it?
